claim.claim-text: 1. A computer/software system for managing telecommunication network elements, comprising: one or more operator-driven processes which monitor and manage network elements; and an operator interface which gives operators the option to view groups of network elements, individual network elements, or subcomponents of network elements; wherein said operator interface also permits operators to optionally command operations on said groups of network elements, or on individual ones of said network elements.

2. A computer/software system for managing telecommunication network cross-connects, comprising: an operator interface which graphically displays cross-connects for a selected network element, said operator interface including a display management feature which permits the operator to request display of cross-connect between any two specified points, and which, in response thereto, makes such a cross-connect visible in the operator's display; and one or more operator-driven processes which permit an operator to selectably view, modify, and delete portions of said cross-connect.

3. A computer/software system for managing telecommunication network elements, comprising: one or more operator-driven processes which monitor and manage network elements; and an operator interface which permits operators to work from graphical representations of connection topology, and which also, when an operator properly inputs identification of a specific network element, automatically performs discovery of characteristics of said specific network element, and presents said specific network element, in a way which is dependent on said characteristics, for the operator to monitor or manage.

4. A computer/software system for managing telecommunication network elements, comprising: one or more operator-driven processes which monitor and manage network elements in real time, using at least one telecommunications network control channel; and automatically initiated background processes which remotely backup information which has been locally stored in ones of said network elements.

5. A computer/software system for managing telecommunication network elements, comprising: one or more operator-driven processes which monitor and manage network elements in real time, using at least one telecommunications network control channel; a database which reports attributes of ones of said network elements in response to queries from ones of said operator-driven processes; and a computer which includes multiple parallel processors and which can run multiple threads simultaneously in parallel; wherein said computer performs management of said database, for respective ones of said network elements, by associating ones of said elements to respective ones of said threads, without otherwise associating ones of said elements with ones of said processors.

6. A computer/software system for managing telecommunication network elements, comprising: one or more operator-driven processes which monitor and manage network elements in real time, using at least one telecommunications network control channel; a database which reports attributes of ones of said network elements in response to queries from ones of said operator-driven processes; and one or more background processes which monitor communications over said control channel and which parse all communications which imply network element status changes and which dynamically update said database accordingly, in real time.

7. A system for managing telecommunication network elements, comprising: stored data representing identifications of specific types of elements and/or components, and, for each identified type, identification of the characteristics of said type, and identification of fully-qualified versions of said type, including, for each fully-qualified version, identification of any special features which are version-dependent; and at least one process which can manage a selected element by obtaining type and version identification for said selected element, and managing said selected element either in accordance with the last fully-qualified version which is no later than the version identification of said selected element, regardless or whether a higher-numbered fully-qualified version exists, or in accordance with a standard specification if there is no fully-qualified version which is not later than the version identification of said selected element.
